description_en: Queries the details of a broadcast device, including the device status and available space
description_zh: 查询播报设备的详情，包括设备的状态、设备的可用空间等
name: GetSpeechDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html可以获取该参数
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

AvailableSpace.description_en: The active space of the device. Unit: KB

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符

ProductKey.description_en: The unique identifier of the product

SpeechListUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the speech corpus list on the device was last updated
SpeechListUpdateTime.description_zh: 设备中语料列表的更新时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the device. Valid values:

ONLINE: Online.
OFFLINE: Offline.
UNACTIVE: Not activated.
DISABLE: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备的状态。

ONLINE：在线。
OFFLINE：离线。
UNACTIVE：未激活。
DISABLE：禁用

TotalSpace.description_en: The total space of the device. Unit: KB

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
